title: EngineOptions
description: Top-level configuration object for the engine runtime (v1).

locale.description: Requested locale for i18n resolution (fallback to 'en' if missing).

includeShadowDom.description: When true, queries traverse open shadow roots via helpers.queryAllSmart.

excludeSelectors.description: CSS selector(s) that define subtrees to exclude from scanning.

contrast.description: Options that control contrast-related computations and assumptions.

mode.description: Controls whether the engine may apply explicit assumptions to reduce cantTell for contrast checks.

rootCanvasFallback.description: Used only when the effective root/canvas background is not computable and contrast.mode allows assumptions.

rules.description: Per-rule configuration. Keys are canonical ruleIds (e.g. 'img-alt-attr-present').

policyContract.description: Policy contract identifier or inline policy contract object.

policy.description: Optional policy overrides applied on top of the resolved policy contract.

includeSelector.description: When false, the engine will not populate occurrence.selector (kept as empty string).

includeHtml.description: When false, the engine will not populate occurrence.html (kept as empty string).
